agents.name: Demo Renovation Assistant
agents.purpose: Answer homeowners on WhatsApp: understand the renovation (property type, rooms, budget range the customer gives, timeline), book a site measurement visit, and hand quotations to a designer.
agents.persona: warm, short and professional; Singapore customers
handover_when: anything about prices not in the approved price list
rules: Ask one question at a time.
Never invent prices or promise dates.

automations.name: Call new enquiries that went quiet

actions.title: Call {first_name}: no reply since the first message

actions.instruction: Politely check whether the customer has questions about quotation {quote_number}; offer to book the next step. No pressure, no new prices.
actions.fallback_text: Hi {first_name}, just checking if you have any questions about quotation {quote_number} from {business}?

actions.text: Quotation {quote_number} has had no answer for 2 days. The AI assistant followed up.

automations.name: Tell the owner about overdue invoices

actions.text: Invoice {invoice_number} is overdue. A reminder draft is ready for you to send.

automations.name: Rebook customers who missed their appointment

actions.instruction: The customer missed their {service} today. Kindly offer to book a new time.
actions.fallback_text: Hi {first_name}, we missed you today. Would you like to book a new time?

actions.text: {first_name} missed their {service}. The AI assistant offered a new time.

to_confirm: Price list (the AI only quotes approved prices)
Their WhatsApp Business number and Meta business verification (for the live system)
Excel files of past customers to import (column check)
Xero: an admin connects it once

problems.problem: WhatsApp enquiries are answered late and forgotten
problems.solution: The AI assistant answers in seconds and every enquiry gets an owner and a reminder
Automatic follow-up after 2 days, owner told
Invoices from accepted quotations, sent into Xero
